verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ubuntu ships toolchains, offers the full package archive, and documents installing individual applications. Nothing shows a single command that provisions a complete set of developer packages, tools, and runtimes ready to use. Per-application installs and archive access are adjacent capabilities, not the one-command setup the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full set of packages, tools, and runtimes ready to use with a single command
